faq_heading: Homes near Princess Margaret Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Princess Margaret Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Princess Margaret Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Princess Margaret Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Princess Margaret Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 242 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,250,000, townhomes $708,000, condos $475,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Princess Margaret Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Princess Margaret Secondary the median was 33 days on the market, closing at 96.7% of the list price, with 10% of sales above the list price for the 242 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Princess Margaret Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Dr F D Sinclair Elementary (0.6 km north), W E Kinvig Elementary (0.8 km east) and Gabrielle-Roy (0.8 km south-east).

Princess Margaret Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 12870 72 Ave. It teaches grades 8 to 12.
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Princess Margaret Secondary, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the Princess Margaret Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Princess Margaret Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Princess Margaret Secondary sold for

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 242 homes sold within 2 km of Princess Margaret Secondary: 103 houses, 85 townhomes and 48 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,250,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Princess Margaret Secondary

31 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Princess Margaret Secondary in a straight line (23 elementary, 5 secondary, 3 other; 6 independent). The closest is Dr F D Sinclair Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is J T Brown Elementary, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Tamanawis Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (1.1 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (1.8 km). Other secondary schools close by: Tamanawis Secondary (1.3 km south-west), Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (1.8 km south-east), Frank Hurt Secondary (2.4 km north-east), iLearn Secondary School Society (2.4 km south-east), Seaquam Secondary (2.8 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Tamanawis Secondary, 1.3 km south-west of Princess Margaret Secondary.
